name: Find all taxa below the clade S. cerevisiae
code:
PREFIX gnom: <https://w3id.org/gnom/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?x ?name
WHERE {
  ?x gnom:parent_taxon ?genus .
  ?genus rdfs:label "Saccharomyces cerevisiae" .
  ?x rdfs:label ?name .
}

name: Find all genes with Bacterial assignments from taXaminer
code:
PREFIX gnom: <https://w3id.org/gnom/>
PREFIX biolink: <https://w3id.org/biolink/vocab/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?y ?x ?name
WHERE {
  ?y gnom:in_taxon ?x .
  ?x gnom:parent_taxon* ?genus .
  ?genus rdfs:label "Bacteria" .
  ?x rdfs:label ?name .
}
